    • LightPlayer

      public LightPlayer(String nickname, TotemColor totemColor, int food, int prestige, boolean isConnected, List<String> characterCards, List<String> buildingCards)
      A light player is created from server-provided values.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the player nickname
      totemColor - the player totem color
      food - the current food amount
      prestige - the current prestige amount
      isConnected - true if the player is connected, false otherwise
      characterCards - the acquired character card identifiers
      buildingCards - the acquired building card identifiers

  • Method Details

    • canAffordAdditionalBuilding

      public boolean canAffordAdditionalBuilding(List<String> alreadySelectedBuildingIds, String additionalBuildingId)
      An additional building card is checked against the player's available food. The cumulative cost of buildings already selected in the ui is considered.
      Parameters:
      alreadySelectedBuildingIds - the list of building IDs already selected in the UI
      additionalBuildingId - the extra building ID to evaluate
      Returns:
      true if the player has enough food, false otherwise
